title: 捡回来
logline: 16岁少年江野在父亲江建军的严苛陪练下，于凌晨老球馆磨砺不服输的球心。

shots.narrationZh: 凌晨四点，老球馆的灯先亮了。
shots.narrationEn: The lights of the old gym turn on at 4 a.m.
shots.visual: Dim old training gym with worn wooden floors, faded old championship flags on the wall, stacks of ping pong balls by the corner, high windows showing faint dawn light, Jiang Jianjun in worn sport coat with frayed cuffs walks to the table first.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉静带暖意，语速偏缓，「先」字重读，气息平稳带清晨清冽感，起句轻收稳

shots.visual: Jiang Jianjun stands opposite the table, his toned forearms visible, sends a sharp fast ping pong ball, Jiang Ye in red sweat-soaked jersey with wrist muscle tape on his wrist leans forward to receive, his eyes stubborn.

lines.en: Keep your eyes on the ball, no daydreaming.

shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳带压迫感，语速偏慢字字有力，重音落在肌肉紧绷的暗示上，气息沉稳带压迫感

shots.visual: Jiang Ye misses the incoming ball, slams his racket on the worn wooden table hard, shoulders heaving, sweat dripping from his short hair, his face twisted with frustration.
shots.ttsDirection: 忿忿带怒意，语速稍快，「不动」重读，气息带喘意，尾音带赌气上扬

shots.visual: Jiang Jianjun stands still with an expressionless face, chin slightly raised, pointing at the fallen racket on the floor with his racket.
shots.ttsDirection: 冷硬不带温度，语速极慢字字砸重，「捡」字重读，气息沉冷，句尾停顿半秒

shots.narrationZh: 捡回来的，从来不是球，是不服。
shots.narrationEn: What you pick up is never the ball, it's the refusal to give up.
shots.visual: The final ping pong ball grazes the net and drops softly on the table, both stand silent staring at the ball, the first beam of dawn light shines on their determined faces, a sharp friction sound of sneakers on the floor echoes, close-up of the professional ping pong racket with brand logo placed on the table.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉劲带力量，语速偏缓，「不是球」「不服」重读，气息稳沉，尾音收得干脆带余劲
